notes: All quotes verbatim on Wikiquote (Project Hail Mary page, the film): 'Fist my bump', 'They toot to scoot', 'Time go fishing, question?', 'small-to-medium whoop', 'Amaze. Amaze. Amaze.', 'Leave now. Statement.', 'Words of GREAT encouragement!', 'Carl and I made a baby'. Rocky as a five-legged mechanical engineer from Erid, Tau Ceti at 11.9 light years and Adrian named for Rocky's mate are in Wikipedia. The signed note 'I put the not in astronaut!' does not print on the card.

vibe.verdict: Rocky's best lines carry the lab ration sheet, and the food is lively, but the stock lab badge and the missing note keep it from a 5.
